cases.description: Well-written new module: parameterised lookups, explicit None checks, validated input. Expected: no findings.
cases.diff:
diff --git a/app/discounts.py b/app/discounts.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1111111
--- /dev/null
+++ b/app/discounts.py
@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+def compute_discount(plan, coupon_code):
+    """Return the discount fraction for a coupon on a plan."""
+    if coupon_code is None:
+        return 0.0
+    coupon = coupons.find_by_code(coupon_code)
+    if coupon is None or coupon.is_expired():
+        return 0.0
+    if coupon.plan_id is not None and coupon.plan_id != plan.id:
+        return 0.0
+    return min(coupon.percent_off, plan.max_discount)
+
+
+def apply_discount(amount, discount):
+    if discount < 0.0 or discount > 1.0:
+        raise ValueError("discount must be between 0 and 1")
+    return round(amount * (1.0 - discount), 2)
